If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase the forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast to match recent 5-day average if true outcome deviates >1.5%.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a 3-day downtrend, forecast must be adjusted upward by 1–3% in the next 5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is >65, reduce forecast by 2–4% for the next 5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is <60, increase forecast by 1–3% for the next 5 days.
